name: Sanchorreja (Spain)
description: Square flag divided horizontally by an indented line, yellow above and green below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sanchorreja (three sheep on green beneath a mitre on yellow).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 26 August 2002 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 64 of 3 April 2003); the arms show three white sheep on green under an indented chief of gold charged with a red bishop's mitre.

features.role: Sanchorreja arms — three sheep beneath a mitre
